title: Answers to Documents
description:
An adapter component that turns model/agent answers into embeddable documents. 
It reads the answers lane and emits one document per validated fact (a JSON array 
yields one document per item; a JSON object or plain-text answer yields a single 
document), so an LLM's structured, self-describing output can be embedded and indexed 
back into a vector store. The original answer is also passed through unchanged, letting 
a pipeline index the answer and keep serving it in the same run.
